title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source to IXI Technology Inc
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.SPAWAR.SPAWAR PACIFIC.NIWC PACIFIC
detail_text: The Department of the Navy, Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific (NIWC Pacific) hereby publicizes its intention to solicit, negotiate, and award a Firm-Fixed-Price purchase order on a noncompetitive basis with IXI Technology Inc The requirement is for the purchase of the Shipboard Peripheral Replacement System (SPRS), part number PR-96110-08-00801,configured with an 8-channel 28840 interface, dual SSDs, dual Blu-ray drives, a sealed keyboard, and Windows 11, is required as a direct replacement system that fully meets the operational and technical needs of the Aegis Baseline 5 Human-Machine Interface used to control AN/UYK-43 computers. This notice of intent is NOT a request for quote. A determination by the Government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the government. The applicable NAICS Code is 334290 and the business size standard is 800 (Employees) Acquisition of Commercial Items under FAR Part 12 apply. The point of contact for this announcement is: Skyler Weiden at Skyler.m.weiden.civ@us.navy.mil. Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. This notice is not a request for quotes; however, any firm believing that they can fulfill the requirement may be considered by the agency. Interested parties may identify their interest and capabilities in response to this synopsis. Any comments, questions or concerns regarding this notice may be submitted via email to Skyler.m.weiden.civ@us.navy.mil. by 06MAR2026 at 1400 PST. Questions by phone or fax will not be considered. All responding vendors must have active registration with the System for Award Management (SAM) Web.
